definitions.gloss: tidying up, cleaning up, putting away
definitions.explanation: The act of organizing and putting things in order.
Completing or settling a matter or task.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{片付|かたづ}けをする。
{片付|かたづ}けが{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I'm not good at tidying up.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{後|あと}は{片付|かたづ}けを{手伝|てつだ}う。
examples.english: I help clean up after meals.

notes:
{片付|かたづ}け is the noun form of {片付|かたづ}ける (to tidy up).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {片付|かたづ}けをする (to do tidying up)
- {片付|かたづ}けが{上手|じょうず}/{苦手|にがて} (good/bad at tidying)
- {片付|かたづ}けを{手伝|てつだ}う (to help tidy up)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {部屋|へや}の{片付|かたづ}け (room tidying)
- {食後|しょくご}の{片付|かたづ}け (cleaning up after meals)
- {大|おお}{掃除|そうじ} (big cleaning, spring cleaning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {片付|かたづ}け: tidying, organizing
- {掃除|そうじ}: cleaning (removing dirt)
- {整理|せいり}: organizing, arranging
